items.title: Kraken parent Payward to acquire Tribe Capital to expand private-market offerings
items.summary: The deal will add private-market sourcing, underwriting, and fund management capabilities to Payward's platform.

items.title: Standard Chartered, StraitsX, OCBC complete trial of tokenized deposit interoperability
items.summary: The companies said that unlocking the full potential of 'always-on' tokenized deposits requires interoperability across platforms.

items.title: Senators: Treasury must ensure equal footing for stablecoin issuers in GENIUS Act implementation
items.summary: Senators are pressing Treasury Secretary Bessent to grant a safe harbor for stablecoin issuers operating under state regulatory frameworks.

items.title: Binance obtains $6.5 billion freezing order from Abu Dhabi court in bid to recover stolen crypto
items.summary: Binance has obtained a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order from the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts as it seeks to recover crypto stolen in October hack.

items.title: Ondo to launch tokenized Anthropic stock on IPO day
items.summary: Ondos ANTon token will track Anthropic shares from the day the Claude maker starts trading on Nasdaq.

items.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin is back in a bearish phase but has reached a value zone
items.summary: Bitcoin has dipped below its 200-day and 365-day moving averages of $72,900 and $75,900, respectively, CryptoQuant said.
